canonClaims.claim: Lumos produces illumination at the caster's wand tip; Nox extinguishes that magical light.
Reparo can mend certain damaged objects; mending a wand's exterior does not restore its damaged magic.

startAssumptions: Learner: adult, magically eligible, owns intact wand, knows Lumos/Nox, in dim storage room.
Visitor: adult, nonmagical, owns wand, no magical source or learned casting.

actions.name: Cast Lumos
actions.preconditions: Owning wand AND magically eligible AND learned Lumos
actions.sourceVsDesign: Effect based on H1; eligibility/knowledge requirements are P1/O1 design.

actions.name: Cast Nox
actions.preconditions: Owning wand AND magically eligible AND learned Nox
actions.sourceVsDesign: Effect based on H1; eligibility/knowledge requirements are P1/O1 design.

actions.name: Cast Reparo
actions.preconditions: Owning wand AND magically eligible AND learned Reparo
actions.sourceVsDesign: Effect based on H2; learner currently lacks learned Reparo per P1.

counterexamples: Nonmagical visitor with wand attempting Lumos: Refusal (no magical source/learned casting).
Learner attempting Reparo: Refusal (not yet learned per P1).
Failed cast: No mutation, no new mastery, no items granted.
futureWitness: Persistence: light state and identity saved
Reparo: physical mend only, no magic restoration
numericalPolicy: No numerical duration, energy, cooldown, or currency values are defined in this inert proposal.
